description: Angular component for managing aggregated data keys panel in a widget configuration UI, including form handling, data key management, and integration with widget callbacks.

classes.name: AggregatedDataKeysPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor for managing a list of data keys in a widget configuration panel.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscription.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, updating parameters accordingly.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for propagating value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the form control values based on provided data keys.

methods.name: keysFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array of keys.

methods.name: trackByKey
methods.description: Track function for form array items.

methods.name: removeKey
methods.description: Removes a key at specified index.

methods.name: addKey
methods.description: Adds a new data key control to the form array.

methods.name: prepareKeysFormArray
methods.description: Prepares a form array from a list of data keys.
